summary: Clarify runtime state required for rollback after the start-operation upgrade

replay.detail: Documentation introduces no additional projection replay or recovery trigger.

schema.detail: No additional schema or storage-version change; this clarifies the separately classified version-19 upgrade.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No additional runtime or client protocol change. New operation-provenance generation records from the start-operation upgrade remain unreadable by older exec runtimes.

downtime.detail: Documentation requires no restart or additional deployment interruption.

manual.detail: Before swapping back after the start-operation upgrade, verify closure of all producers and operation-owned runtimes, preserve the upgraded ledger and generation records, and restore compatible pre-upgrade runtime state together with SQLite and the matching binary. Restoring SQLite alone is insufficient. See docs/seat-lifecycle.md#pending-runtime-starts.

recovery.detail: Operation-provenance exec records cannot be read by older runtime binaries. Preserve them as evidence after verified retirement and restore the consistent pre-upgrade runtime state; do not lower the SQLite header or erase unresolved authority. Roll forward when exact producer/runtime closure or consistent restored state cannot be established.
